checkpoints.description: [1/4] Combat-feedback cycle: baseline evidence harness, damage-source tracking, HUD direction cue, play/gate proof

impact_assessment.why: Baseline screenshots and play notes show no directional feedback when enemies hit from off-screen; HP only drops.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players can locate the threat that hurt them; adds combat legibility without changing balance or damage.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot gains a hurt field, so pinned hashes move; dependency: no new deps; concurrency: none; state: new transient timers must reset with sim.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep gameplay fields unchanged, verify event/hp parity against baseline, add determinism and reset tests; presentation-only HUD reads sim.

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Combat feedback implemented and proven: 43 tests, determinism 1800 ok, before/after 292px cue deltas, played-run parity; checklists: passed
[1/3] Enemies/bosses cycle: warden data/wave, telegraphed slam, summons, HUD bar/core, play + visual proof

impact_assessment.why: Post-win wave 3 was only a count bump with no elite or boss readout.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a designed wave-3 escalation and a killable 600-hp boss without touching the wave 1-2 win path.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot/enemy data grow; dependency: none; concurrency: summons mutate the enemy list during the step; state: wave-3 unlock changes endless pacing only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Bound summons by max_alive, add attack cooldown to escorts, pin win-path hash and fairness tests, verify determinism and budget.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Warden boss proven: 50 tests, determinism 1800 ok, same-build 60282px boss pair, boss kill at 507f and wave-4 campaign; checklists: passed
[1/2] Levels cycle: surge pickup beacon + distance label, presentation-only, visual pair and pickup run

impact_assessment.why: The wave-2 surge pickup is fully occluded by the centre cover from spawn; players get no visible cue to the reward.
impact_assessment.benefits: Makes the level affordance discoverable without moving the pickup or changing its trigger/economy.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (snapshot unchanged); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: two presentation nodes must hide after the pickup and on rebuild.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Tests pin visibility/position/hide and the 18m label gate; baseline-vs-after pickup run must match hash, events and final state.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Pickup beacon proven: 54 tests, determinism 1800 ok, 2342px same-state pair, pickup run hash identical; checklists: passed
